column1: # Every public number, and the control that has to stay silent for it to count.
# scripts/check-claims.sh runs each row and fails if the output drifts.
#   id        short name; controls start with "control-"
#   speed     fast (every push) or slow (weekly job, or --all)
#   exit      expected exit code of the command
#   command   run from the repo root; `struktura` is replaced by $STRUKTURA_BIN
#   expect    strings that must all appear in the output, separated by " && "
